🦠Recently, rumors have been circulating about a "new epidemic" in China, with claims of packed hospitals, overwhelmed crematoriums, and multiple viruses spreading.

The viruses are:
1) Influenza A
2) Mycoplasma pneumoniae
3) hMPV (Human Metapneumovirus)
